name: ServiceNow
desc: Enterprise IT service management platform for incident, change, and service request management

actions.name: create_record
actions.description: Create a new record in a specified table

actions.name: update_record
actions.description: Update an existing record in a specified table

actions.name: get_record
actions.description: Retrieve a specific record by its ID

actions.name: find_record
actions.description: Search for records in a table using a query

actions.name: delete_record
actions.description: Delete a record from a specified table

actions.name: add_comment
actions.description: Append a customer-visible comment or an internal work note to a record (incident, request, problem, change, etc.)

actions.name: resolve_incident
actions.description: Move an incident to Resolved or Closed with a close code and resolution notes

actions.name: attach_file_to_record
actions.description: Upload and attach a file to a record

actions.name: find_file
actions.description: List or download file attachments from a record

actions.name: delete_attachment
actions.description: Delete an attachment by its sys_id

actions.name: get_catalog_item
actions.description: Retrieve full details of a catalog item including its variable definitions. Use this before "Submit Catalog Request" to discover the variables expected by the item.

actions.name: submit_catalog_item
actions.description: Order a catalog item. Submits a service catalog request and returns the resulting request number.

actions.name: search_knowledge_articles
actions.description: Search published knowledge base articles using free text. Requires the Knowledge API plugin to be active.

actions.name: get_knowledge_article
actions.description: Retrieve the full content of a knowledge article by sys_id

actions.name: send_email
actions.description: Send an email through your ServiceNow instance using the Email API. Requires the email outbound capability to be configured.

actions.name: count_records
actions.description: Return the number of records in a table that match an optional encoded query (uses the Aggregate API)

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_record
triggers.description: Triggers when a new record is created in a table

triggers.name: updated_record
triggers.description: Triggers when a record is updated in a table

triggers.name: new_comment
triggers.description: Triggers when a new comment or work note is added to a record in the selected table
